info.title: Abol Kit API
info.description: HTTP API for Abol Kit. This process does not run speech-to-text. The worker calls a separate MMS ASR service (TRANSCRIBER_URL). No path in this document accepts audio or returns a transcript.

servers.description: This API origin. A host page on another origin calls it with CORS.

get.description: Reports that this API process is up. It does not call the speech-to-text service. That service is a separate MMS ASR wrapper reached only by the worker.
